description: This Java class models a digital signal as a sequence of UpDown events, providing parsing, time translation, and signal analysis functionalities within the 'com.rusefi.waves' package.

classes.name: EngineReport
classes.description: Represents a digital signal as a sequence of UpDown events, with methods for parsing, time conversion, and comparison.

classes.name: EngineReport.UpDown
classes.description: Inner class representing an up-down event with timing and index information, including methods for duration and duty cycle calculation.

methods.name: EngineReport
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the report from a string or list of UpDown events.

methods.name: isCloseEnough
methods.description: Checks if two double values are within a ratio threshold.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns the list of UpDown events.

methods.name: getMaxTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum timestamp in systicks.

methods.name: getMinTime
methods.description: Returns the minimum timestamp in systicks.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a report string into a list of UpDown events.

methods.name: timeToScreen
methods.description: Converts a time value to a screen coordinate based on width.

methods.name: screenToTime
methods.description: Converts a screen coordinate back to a time value.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the signal in systicks.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the EngineReport.

methods.name: UpDown
methods.description: Represents an up-down event with timing and index data, and methods for duration and duty cycle.

methods.name: UpDown.getDuration
methods.description: Calculates the duration of the UpDown event.

methods.name: UpDown.toString
methods.description: String representation of an UpDown event.

methods.name: UpDown.getDutyCycle
methods.description: Calculates the duty cycle based on crank angle and time.
